text: The initiative is part of New Zealand's Budget 2024 and includes a $9.1 million allocation for addressing damage to conservation sites and assets, and $13.2 million for protecting cultural heritage. It involves collaboration with iwi/hapū, local councils, community groups, and other partners. The initiative focuses on site assessments, debris clearance, asset repair, and heritage conservation, supported by DOC's statutory roles.

metadata.solution_name: Debris and Sediment Clearance and Cultural Asset Restoration (Budget 2024)
